User.title: User
User.description: User profile with SaaS subscription plan and token balance

photoURL.description: Profile picture URL or empty string

trialStartDate.description: Trial start date ISO string or null

trialEndDate.description: Trial end date ISO string or null

hasUsedTrial.description: Whether the user has already activated their one-time free trial

monthlyTokenAllocation.description: Monthly recurring token allocation or null

subscriptionStartDate.description: Paid subscription start date ISO string or null

subscriptionEndDate.description: Paid subscription end date ISO string or null

billingCycle.description: Billing cadence such as monthly or null

paymentProvider.description: Payment provider like stripe or razorpay or null

paymentCustomerId.description: Payment gateway customer identifier or null

paymentSubscriptionId.description: Payment gateway subscription identifier or null

TokenTransaction.title: TokenTransaction
TokenTransaction.description: Immutable audit record of token deductions and credits

uid.description: User ID who owns this transaction

amount.description: Number of tokens deducted or credited

balanceBefore.description: User token balance before this transaction

balanceAfter.description: User token balance after this transaction

referenceId.description: Optional reference ID e.g. report generation ID

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Authoritative ledger record of verified Razorpay payments and subscriptions

uid.description: User ID who owns this payment

plan.description: Plan purchased e.g. monthly or oneTime

razorpayOrderId.description: Razorpay order ID for one-time payments or null

amount.description: Payment amount in rupees e.g. 1999 or 4999

status.description: Payment status e.g. captured, active, or cancelled

tokensGranted.description: Number of tokens credited to user balance

createdAt.description: Payment record creation timestamp in ISO format

updatedAt.description: Payment record update timestamp in ISO format

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key to ensure transactions and webhooks are processed exactly once

/users/{uid}.description: User profile and SaaS membership metadata

/tokenTransactions/{transactionId}.description: Individual token debit or credit ledger records

/payments/{paymentId}.description: Authoritative records of verified Razorpay payments and subscriptions
